headline: CAMBRIA GOLD HITS 98.56 G/T AU OVER 8.2M AT SILVER COIN — PREMIER GOLD PROJECT GRADES RIVAL BEST IN BRITISH COLUMBIA
snippet: Cambria Gold Mines (TSXV: CAMB) reported 98.56 g/t gold over 8.2 metres from the Silver Coin deposit at its Premier Gold Project in British Columbia — a grade that ranks among the highest narrow-width intercepts reported on the TSX Venture this year. Premier Gold is a historically producing camp where past operators returned millions of ounces; Cambria is advancing Silver Coin alongside several other high-priority targets, and the depth extension confirmed by this hole significantly expands the deposit's resource potential.

headline: RAPID CRITICAL METALS DRILLS 2,089 G/T SILVER FROM 24M DEPTH — AUSTRALIA'S HIGHEST-GRADE UNDEVELOPED SILVER PROJECT GROWS
snippet: Rapid Critical Metals (ASX: RCM) reported hole WSRC0033 at its Webbs Silver Project in New South Wales returning 4 metres grading 2,089 g/t silver (2,334 g/t AgEq) from just 24 metres, the highest single-interval grade yet released from the project and confirming the shoot remains open at depth. Webbs already carries a combined resource in excess of 67 million ounces AgEq following the Webbs Consol acquisition from Lode Resources, and the shallow high-grade intersection suggests open-pit viability may improve further as drilling continues. A scoping study is on the horizon.

headline: McFARLANE LAKE LAUNCHES FULLY FUNDED 50,000M PHASE 2 AT JUBY — TARGETS CANADA'S NEXT TIER-1 GOLD RESOURCE ON 6.16M OZ BASE
snippet: McFarlane Lake Mining (CSE: MLM) outlined a fully funded 50,000-metre Phase 2 drill program at its Juby Gold Project in Ontario, targeting resource expansion off a current base of 1.07 million indicated ounces and 5.09 million inferred ounces — totalling approximately 6.16 million ounces at grades averaging 0.87–0.95 g/t Au. The Phase 2 program is designed to convert inferred ounces to indicated, add new strike-length discoveries, and support a preliminary economic assessment that would position Juby as one of the largest near-development gold projects in Northern Ontario.

headline: GOLD EDGES HIGHER AS TRADERS PARE OCTOBER FED HIKE BETS — SPOT AT $4,165, SILVER FIRM AT $57.30
snippet: Spot gold edged toward $4,165 on October 19 as futures traders reduced bets on an imminent Federal Reserve rate hike following remarks from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh that did not signal an October move, lifting short-term real-yield pressure from bullion. Silver firmed in tandem to approximately $57.30. Both metals remain well below their February 2026 peaks — gold's $4,873 and silver's near-$70 high — but the paring of aggressive hawkish positioning offers near-term technical support ahead of the October 27-28 FOMC meeting.

headline: COPPER RECORD PRICES ARE THE EASY PART — 17-YEAR MINE PIPELINE LAG MEANS THE REAL SQUEEZE STARTS IN 2029
snippet: A Washington Times analysis published October 19 argues that while copper near $14,500/tonne grabs headlines, the structural story is a 17-year average mine development timeline combined with an IEA forecast of a 25% supply shortfall by 2035 — with even committed projects only narrowing the gap modestly. Near-term the International Copper Study Group sees a refined-copper surplus through 2027, but existing mine output may begin declining as early as 2029 per Teck's CEO. For investors in copper development assets, the analysis underscores why project pipeline optionality is being priced into juniors with Tier-1 deposits even at current elevated valuations.

headline: AURUM RESOURCES HITS 57M AT 2.34 G/T AU AT BOUNDIALI — WEST AFRICA EXPLORER EYES END-OF-MONTH RESOURCE UPDATE ON 3.22MOZ BASE
snippet: Aurum Resources (ASX: AUE) reported assay results from 25 diamond holes at its Boundiali Gold Project in Côte d'Ivoire, including a headline intercept of 57 metres at 2.34 g/t Au from the BST1 zone — a bulk-tonnage, open-pittable interval that fits the project's low-strip geometry. Aurum is targeting an updated mineral resource estimate by end of October 2026, building on a current 3.22 million-ounce resource (1.70Moz Indicated, 1.52Moz Inferred), with the new drill data expected to increase the Indicated category and support a move toward a scoping study.

headline: GOLD MINING STOCKS FACE 23% MARGIN SQUEEZE HEADING INTO Q4 AS $711 SPOT PULLBACK MEETS STICKY COSTS
snippet: A Discovery Alert analysis argues that gold's $711/oz retreat from February's $4,873 record is carving approximately 23% off producer margins even as industry all-in sustaining costs remain near $1,785/oz sector-wide — a squeeze that disproportionately hits unhedged mid-tier producers and those with royalty-linked sliding-scale cost structures. The piece identifies producers with AISC above $1,700/oz as most exposed if spot gold fails to reclaim $4,400 before Q4 earnings season and cautions that the central bank buying floor that supports bullion provides no direct insulation for equity margins when royalty and energy costs rise faster than production revenue.

headline: LONG-TERM URANIUM HITS 18-YEAR HIGH AT $97/LB — EQUITIES STILL HAVEN'T CAUGHT UP TO CONTRACT PRICE SURGE
snippet: TradeTech's long-term uranium price indicator reached $97/lb, the highest reading since July 2007 and above the previous 19-year record of $95/lb, while spot closed the week of October 17 at $89.90/lb — essentially unchanged for three consecutive weeks. Uranium Unleashed's analysis notes the divergence between contract pricing (driven by utility re-contracting urgency) and equity performance, arguing that producers' stock prices have not kept pace with the historic contract price move. For TSX-listed uranium developers, a sustained $97/lb long-term price supports the kind of long-dated offtake agreements that underpin project financing decisions like Aura Energy's recently completed Tiris BFS.

headline: LUNNON METALS HUSTLER RETURNS 6M AT 4.31 G/T AU — FOSTER-BAKER NICKEL CAMP GOLD RESOURCE UPDATE DUE WITHOUT FURTHER DRILLING
snippet: Lunnon Metals (ASX: LM8) released final assays from the Hustler Footwall zone at its Foster-Baker project in Western Australia, with hole HUS26RC_034 returning 6 metres grading 4.31 g/t gold from 29 metres. Lunnon confirmed that no further drilling is required before it publishes an updated mineral resource estimate for Hustler, which currently stands at 826,000 tonnes at 1.4 g/t Au for 36,200 ounces — but the new footwall intercepts, if incorporated, suggest meaningful grade uplift in the updated estimate. The company is advancing Hustler alongside its primary Kambalda nickel assets.

headline: SELKIRK COPPER DRILLS 44.7M AT 2.12% CU AND 1.16 G/T AU AT MINTO — YUKON PORPHYRY SYSTEM EXTENDS LATERALLY
snippet: Selkirk Copper (TSX-V: SKRKF) reported drill hole results from the Minto Copper-Gold Project in Yukon returning 44.7 metres grading 2.12% copper, 1.16 g/t gold, and 10.7 g/t silver — a copper-gold interval comparable to the grades that made Minto economically viable under prior operators. The result tests the lateral extent of the known porphyry system, with the company targeting a resource update to support a preliminary economic assessment. Minto has a permitted mill and existing infrastructure on site, reducing development capital relative to greenfield copper porphyry projects at comparable grade.
